description: Land Title Settlement Department - Thudella, Ja-ela D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 512202
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed information about parcel numbers, extents, owners' names and addresses, title classifications, and any encumbrances. The content is focused entirely on land ownership and property registration, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and land title matters.
